governance.status: ANALYTICAL LITERATURE REVIEW — HYPOTHESES NOT YET PROJECT-VALIDATED
governance.description: Cross-Domain Failure Graph v2: Rigorous separation of DIRECT EVIDENCE from OUR INFERENCE across all failure archetypes.

analogous_failures.our_failure_description: Fixed snapshot POD fails across unseen turbulent seeds (E_u ≈ 99.9%) due to random spatial phase shifts in periodic directions.
analogous_failures.analogous_failure_in_field: Standard linear POD exhibits slow Kolmogorov n-width decay on advecting shocks, traveling pulses, and wave packets.
analogous_failures.direct_literature_evidence: Reiss et al. (2018 SISC) demonstrated that Shifted POD reduces mode count by an order of magnitude for 1D/2D traveling waves. Rowley & Marsden (2000 Physica D) proved that quotienting out continuous Lie group symmetries reduces POD dimension for traveling-wave attractors.
analogous_failures.our_project_inference: IF turbulent cross-seed decorrelation in periodic directions (x, z) is primarily driven by spatial translation/phase drift, THEN symmetry reduction / spatial alignment will reduce cross-seed subspace distance. (Must be validated by R_align pretest before claim).

analogous_failures.our_failure_description: Heuristically pruning small triadic interactions in the modal convection tensor caused catastrophic energy blowup and numerical instability in W7.
analogous_failures.analogous_failure_in_field: Truncating or perturbing quadratic Galerkin interaction tensors destroys skew-symmetry and breaks energy conservation, leading to unphysical amplitude growth in long-term integration.
analogous_failures.direct_literature_evidence: Schlegel & Noack (2015 JFM) proved that preserving skew-symmetry <phi_i, (phi_j·∇)phi_k> + <phi_k, (phi_j·∇)phi_i> = 0 is mathematically necessary and sufficient for energy boundedness of inviscid Galerkin systems.
analogous_failures.our_project_inference: Our OnTheFlyFFTEvaluator succeeded because it evaluates the full continuous skew-symmetric operator on a collocation grid without tensor truncation. Our FFT result is independent project evidence.

analogous_failures.our_failure_description: Derivative-weighted mode selection (W9-A/B) improved wall-shear stress error (E_tau_w dropped to 3.9%), but degraded global velocity field error (E_u > 1.0) because wall-gradient modes displaced bulk kinetic energy modes.
analogous_failures.analogous_failure_in_field: Standard energy-norm POD is suboptimal for goal functionals (lift, drag, sound pressure) because energy-dominant bulk modes do not align with the observable's gradient.
analogous_failures.direct_literature_evidence: Schlegel et al. (2012 JFM) introduced Observable Inferred Decomposition (OID) and proved that optimizing modes for a linear goal functional achieves order-of-magnitude reduction for that functional while departing from optimal full-state L2 energy.
analogous_failures.our_project_inference: Our wall-shear result is an empirical instance of goal-oriented reduction: wall shear stress tau_w is low-rank even when the full 3D velocity field u(x,t) has high Kolmogorov n-width.

analogous_failures.our_failure_description: Global separable Fourier-sine eigenwaves hit an intrinsic representation floor (E_proj ≈ 24.5%) at moderate ranks, and greedy global oracle selection failed to achieve 5% error within r=1152 modes.
analogous_failures.analogous_failure_in_field: Global Fourier bases require high rank O(N) to resolve spatially localized, intermittent structures (Gibbs phenomenon and dense high-wavenumber tails).
analogous_failures.direct_literature_evidence: Farge & Schneider (2001 Phys. Fluids) and Deriaz & Perrier (2006 J. Turbul.) proved that orthogonal wavelet thresholding compresses 3D turbulent fields into sparse non-Gaussian coherent structures (compressible in wavelets) and incoherent background noise.
analogous_failures.our_project_inference: Multiscale solenoidal wave packets (W13-G) are mathematically justified for localized coherent structure extraction and sparse inverse sensor recovery, independent of forward time-stepping ROM capacity.

analogous_failures.our_failure_description: Ramanujan-inspired spectral correction failed to improve continuous Navier-Stokes velocity field prediction.
analogous_failures.analogous_failure_in_field: Arithmetic Ramanujan sums c_q(n) are orthogonal over integer divisibility metrics, not continuous differential operators.
analogous_failures.direct_literature_evidence: Vaidyanathan & Tenneti (2014 IEEE Trans. Signal Process.) established Ramanujan filter banks for discrete integer period identification in digital signals and genomic sequences.
analogous_failures.our_project_inference: Ramanujan transforms must be permanently retired from continuous spatial fluid dynamics, but our implementation is valid for discrete engine cycle periodicity and vibration monitoring.
